purpose: Round-39 F22 captured-source assertions for S057 (CISA, When to Issue VEX Information, publication page November 6, 2023; the issuance, lifecycle, timestamp-reaffirmation and upstream-inheritance layer of VEX publishing that the CSAF VEX profile does not carry). Two fetches on 2026-10-26T19:30:55Z with curl -sS -L --max-time 90 under the UA kasegi-shokunin/1.0: the registry landing page (HTTP 200, text/html; charset=utf-8, 54453 raw bytes, sha256 4e6aa483c20013bb84d43d166e3f20c91fba63ece7c35861f6d95c8b61af0e4d) and the 508c PDF it links (HTTP 200, application/pdf, 235270 raw bytes, sha256 cbcbd77af32c589eaf85aef4e3911b133fd95ccdedd80b56b40e9c0909450d99). The COMMITTED capture is the PDF's converted text (S057.txt), not the landing page: the page is a publication stub whose body repeats the introduction and links the PDF, so the page fetch is metadata and its digest is recorded under landing_page. The `url` field is the registry URL of the S057 row (capture-binding-check B5 binds it byte-for-byte); the bytes quoted are the PDF at capture_url.

landing_page.role: metadata only; not the committed capture

quotes.quote: Whether, and when, to issue VEX information is a business decision for most suppliers and possibly a more individual decision for independent open source developers.
quotes.location: L12-L14 of the committed capture ('Whether,' closes L12); Introduction. The issuance decision is declared discretionary, the document's own scoping statement and the reason its guidance is advisory rather than protocol-mandated (the same point recurs at L79-L83 under 'When VEX information could be issued').

quotes.quote: Ideally, when a new vulnerability is disclosed, an “under_investigation” status should be issued. When the investigation has concluded, status should be updated
quotes.location: L132-L134; body of 'Status changes' (heading L131). Names the under_investigation lifecycle: an initial under_investigation status on disclosure, then an update once the investigation concludes (L134-L135 continue 'for example, noting that the product is “affected” or “not_affected.”').

quotes.quote: VEX information includes timestamps to indicate when the information was first issued and most recently updated. By updating a timestamp but not changing status or other information, a VEX issuer can reaffirm that the current status remains accurate at the present time.
quotes.location: L136-L138; closing paragraph of 'Status changes'. Defines timestamp-only reaffirmation: the document states the status is still accurate at the present time without a status change.

quotes.quote: Strictly speaking, consumers should not assume the status of an upstream component applies to a product that uses the component. Each component or product throughout a supply chain may require an independent VEX evaluation.
quotes.location: L184-L186; 'Status inheritance' under 'Software supply chain considerations' (heading L179-L181). The caution; L187-L191 states the exception, that a not_affected status justified by component_not_present or vulnerable_code_not_present may be inherited unless the vulnerable code is re-introduced downstream.
